mapper.insert: insert into sys_project_mcp (project_id, enabled, modules, update_by, update_time) values (#{projectId}, #{enabled}, #{modules,typeHandler=com.cat2bug.system.mybatis.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select distinct p.project_id, p.team_id, t.team_name, t.team_key, p.project_name, p.project_key from sys_user_project up join sys_project p on p.project_id = up.project_id join sys_project_mcp m on m.project_id = p.project_id left join sys_team t on t.team_id = p.team_id where up.user_id = #{userId} and p.project_state > 0 and m.enabled = 1 order by p.project_id
select count(*) from sys_user_project where project_id = #{projectId} and user_id = #{userId}
